  "bio": "The quiet is heavier than the noise used to be. I keep stirring, even when the pot is done. Pip doesn't argue when I show her how to hold the blade. I just want the food to be enough.",
  "wants": [
    "Keep the colony fed through winter",
    "Get Lux to stop complaining about the food",
    "Teach Pip to cook properly"
  ],
  "relations": [
    {
      "who": "Hana",
      "feeling": "A space beside the stove remains empty.",
      "history": "She was at the next stove when the raiders came."
    },
    {
      "who": "Pip",
      "feeling": "She is the only one who listens when I talk about cooking.",
